chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Sayf, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, who said:
I accompanied al-Riḍā عليه السلام during travel, and I saw him perform the maghrib prayer when the darkness approached from the east—meaning the blackness.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, whose practice is being reported
key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel, the state in which the observation took place
key_terms.السَّوَادَ: the blackness, explaining the meaning of الْفَحْمَةُ in context
key_terms.الْفَحْمَةُ: the darkening or dusky onset appearing in the sky
key_terms.الْمَشْرِقِ: the east, from where the darkness is described as approaching
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبَ: the maghrib salat (prayer), the sunset prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time of maghrib salat (prayer) begin according to this hadith from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the observed practice of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام regarding the time of maghrib salat (prayer) while traveling. It indicates that he performed maghrib when darkness began to appear from the eastern horizon, clarifying the onset of nightfall relevant to the prayer time.
